title: Constructing Synthesizable Evaluations of Technical Interventions to Reduce Wildlife‐Caused Agricultural Losses构建易用于证据整合的野生动物致农业损失缓解措施成效评估
content:
A framework with eight key components to assess the effectiveness of technical measures to reduce wildlife-caused agriculture loss.


ABSTRACT

Technical interventions to reduce wildlife-caused agricultural losses (e.g., crops, livestock, and fisheries) are essential for human-wildlife coexistence. Despite widespread implementations, robust evidence of many interventions remains limited. Moreover, substantial heterogeneity in problem definition, experimental design, outcome measurement, and reporting practices hinder both the interpretability of individual evaluations and the synthesis of cumulative evidence. Here, we identified eight key components to guide the construction of evaluations that are both sensible and synthesizable. These include: (i) defining the problem spatiotemporally; (ii) specifying the intervention and its mechanism; (iii) collaborating with stakeholders; (iv) designing experiments with stronger inference; (v) measuring the functional and monetary effectiveness; (vi) assessing the effects on wildlife and people; (vii) evaluating stakeholder trade-offs; and (viii) reporting standardized evidence for synthesis and practice. We hope these components can help generate more robust evidence to support evidence-based conflict management.

摘要

利用技术干预措施减少野生动物对农作物、牲畜和渔业造成的损失, 对于人与野生动物长期共存至关重要。目前, 众多缺乏实验证据支持的措施已经在实际生产中应用。同时, 由于问题界定、实验设计、成效指标和数据报告方式的巨大差异, 导致已有实验评估之间仍然难以比较和整合评估。本文提出八个关键组成元素, 用于提升案例研究的可靠性和案例之间的可比性, 包括: (1) 从时空尺度等维度清晰界定冲突； (2) 详细阐述干预措施细节及其行为作用机制； (3) 与利益相关者开展合作和设定目标； (4) 采用具有更强因果推断能力的实验设计； (5) 评估干预措施对实际损失和经济效益的影响； (6) 评估其对人和其他野生动物的影响； (7) 分析不同利益相关者对措施各维度影响的权衡；以及 (8) 采用标准化方式报告案例证据。我们希望该框架能够帮助研究人员产生更加可靠和可比较的数据, 促进“基于证据”的人与野生动物冲突管理。
